flashcard_questions.q: Man-made structures built to control or prevent flooding, such as dams, embankments and flood barriers.
A large barrier built across a river to hold back water, creating a reservoir behind it.
An artificial lake created by a dam, used to store water and control river flow.
How much did Cow Green Reservoir on the Tees cost?

flashcard_questions.a: An artificially raised river bank built to increase the channel’s capacity and prevent flooding.
